svg.aria-label: The full mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Session: one literature strategist, or several with a merge, written in config.md (question); Literature strategist, unless you skip it; review.md and refs.bib written with its own edits (agent, only when needed); Literature strategists, the starts the session briefs, at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, the merge the session briefs: review.md and refs.bib written with its own edits (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Planner (agent); A research question the materials do not answer, when a part has no result (stop); Literature strategist: the sections with no source (agent, only when needed); Planner: assigns what was found (agent, only when needed); Planner, fresh: rewrites each argument with two or more weak-argument signs (agent, only when needed); Outline approval: each rewritten argument before and after (stop); Draft writer (agent); Draft writer once more: the model identifier, when the model list gave none or the served one differs (agent, only when needed); Visualization, with data (agent, only when needed); Citation compliance (agent); Citation compliance once more, when a check fails (agent, only when needed); A claim the run cannot support, or a reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the entries fail the same check (stop); Peer reviewer (agent); Draft writer: a patch (agent); Citation compliance for each later patch with a cited sentence: those sentences only (agent, only when needed); The draft review rejects the draft: each Critical issue classed, a roadmap (stop); The draft review does not pass: no answer recommended (stop); Draft writer: reference fix (agent, only when needed); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); Draft writer: compile fix (agent, only when needed); /writing: 4 agents, unless you said no at intake (agent, only when needed); End: the final message, with the /writing report and your reply, optional (agent); Draft writer: applies what you pick (agent, only when needed); Citation compliance: the sentences of the findings pass (agent, only when needed); Peer reviewer: reads the findings pass (agent, only when needed); Draft writer: compile fix (agent, only when needed); Draft writer: the anonymous copy, for a double-blind venue (agent, only when needed); Formatter: the DOCX and Markdown targets you named (agent, only when needed).
